name: Lead Scorer Daily
summary: Scores new HubSpot leads every morning based on company size and recent activity, explains the score, and posts the top 5 to Slack.

items.title: New HubSpot lead reader
items.description: Pulls newly created leads from HubSpot including company size and recent activity details.
items.proved_when: New leads from HubSpot appear in the pipeline daily.

items.title: Daily morning trigger
items.description: Triggers the scoring workflow every morning automatically.
items.proved_when: Workflow runs once a day at the specified morning time.

items.title: Lead scorer and explainer
items.description: Scores each lead from 0 to 100 using company size and activity, and writes an explanation for the score.
items.proved_when: Each lead receives a numeric score and a written reason.
items.source_quote: score new HubSpot leads from 0 to 100 using company size and recent activity, explain each score

items.title: Top leads Slack poster
items.description: Posts the top 5 highest-scoring leads and their explanations to the designated Slack channel.
items.proved_when: A message containing the top 5 leads appears in the Slack channel every morning.

defaults.label: Scoring weight balance
defaults.value: Equal weight between company size and recent activity

questions.text: Which Slack workspace should the top 5 leads be posted to?
